decision_memory.decision_question: Has sodium-ion stationary storage crossed from product and production claims into a procurable, delivered, commissioned technology with public field-operating evidence?

scope.statement: Stationary battery energy storage systems only.
included: Stationary sodium-ion BESS product, supply, delivery, commissioning, field performance, operating history, and replication evidence.
excluded: Buyer-specific procurement suitability without customer context.

evidence_states.label: Stationary product announced
limitations: Product existence does not establish delivery or commissioning.

evidence_states.label: Supply cooperation agreement
limitations: Agreement existence does not establish shipment, acceptance, commissioning, or field performance.

evidence_states.label: Production readiness
limitations: Readiness language remains manufacturer-attributed without independently accepted production evidence.

evidence_states.label: Customer batch delivery
limitations: Planned milestones and supply agreements are not completed delivery records.

evidence_states.label: Named commissioned site
limitations: No qualifying named customer site commissioning or grid-connection record was accepted at the cutoff.

evidence_states.label: Independent field performance
limitations: No customer-linked independent field dataset was accepted at the cutoff.

evidence_states.label: Long operating history
limitations: No qualifying duration, reliability, degradation, incident, or maintenance record was accepted.

evidence_states.label: Lifecycle cost advantage over LFP
limitations: A system-level, duty-cycle-specific comparison is absent.

evidence_states.label: Universal LFP replacement
limitations: No universal substitution conclusion is inferred from product or agreement evidence.

evidence_observations.accepted_support: Sodium-ion technology and a planned industrial-chain target were publicly announced.
evidence_observations.does_not_support: Stationary BESS customer delivery, commissioning, or field-operating history.
limitations: The record predates the TENER Sodium stationary product and does not establish a customer deployment.

evidence_observations.accepted_support: Naxtra sodium-ion products were publicly launched with manufacturer-attributed mass-production claims.
evidence_observations.does_not_support: A delivered or commissioned stationary storage system.
limitations: The cited product family is not itself evidence of a commissioned stationary BESS.

evidence_observations.accepted_support: Two counterparties publicly described a three-year 60 GWh sodium-ion energy-storage cooperation agreement signed on 2026-04-27.
evidence_observations.does_not_support: Shipment, customer acceptance, commissioning, grid connection, or operating performance.
limitations: published_at uses the earliest qualifying public counterparty publication; CATL published its corresponding announcement on 2026-05-06.

evidence_observations.accepted_support: TENER Sodium was publicly launched as a stationary BESS product and future delivery milestones were stated.
evidence_observations.does_not_support: Completed customer delivery or a named commissioned customer site as of the knowledge cutoff; field-validation language remains source-attributed.
limitations: Manufacturer claims about validation, readiness, safety, or performance are not converted into independent field evidence.

evidence_observations.accepted_support: TENER Sodium was publicly showcased and a Brazil market partnership was announced.
evidence_observations.does_not_support: A named commissioned sodium-ion BESS or public field-performance dataset.
limitations: Market activity and product display do not establish customer commissioning or operating history.

decision_state.rationale: The public evidence map establishes market evidence boundaries but cannot determine a buyer-specific procurement decision without architecture, qualification, duty-cycle, geography, certification, economics, and decision-deadline context.

unknowns.question: Has a named customer accepted a batch delivery of a sodium-ion stationary storage system?
unknowns.why_unknown: The accepted public record contains product, partnership, and future-delivery statements but no completed customer acceptance record.
unknowns.minimum_resolving_evidence: Dated, attributable shipment and customer acceptance for a sodium-ion stationary system.
unknowns.resolution_path: Targeted verification of customer, operator, logistics, regulatory, or commissioning records.
unknowns.stop_condition: Stop when one qualifying named customer delivery and acceptance record is verified, or when the authorized search boundary is exhausted.

unknowns.question: Does a named commissioned and grid- or service-operating sodium-ion stationary site exist?
unknowns.why_unknown: A delivered system may not be commissioned, and no qualifying public site record was accepted.
unknowns.minimum_resolving_evidence: Named operator, named site, system boundary, commissioning date, and grid or service status.
unknowns.resolution_path: Targeted verification of operator, project, regulator, utility, or EPC commissioning records.
unknowns.stop_condition: Stop when one qualifying named commissioned site is verified, or when the authorized search boundary is exhausted.

unknowns.question: Is there an independent or customer-linked field-performance dataset for a named sodium-ion stationary system?
unknowns.why_unknown: Manufacturer test and performance language is not equivalent to customer field validation.
unknowns.minimum_resolving_evidence: Independent test or operator dataset with method, system identity, operating boundary, and dated measurements.
unknowns.resolution_path: Verify operator, independent laboratory, insurer, regulator, or grid-service datasets tied to a named system.
unknowns.stop_condition: Stop when a qualifying independent/customer-linked field dataset is accepted or public data is shown insufficient within scope.

unknowns.question: What dated operating history exists for a named sodium-ion stationary system?
unknowns.why_unknown: Commissioning alone would not establish durability, degradation, availability, incident rate, or maintenance burden.
unknowns.minimum_resolving_evidence: Dated runtime, duty cycle, availability, degradation, incidents, and maintenance tied to a named system.
unknowns.resolution_path: Monitor and verify operator disclosures, service records, technical papers, regulator filings, and independent performance reports.
unknowns.stop_condition: Stop when evidence is sufficient for the defined operating-history threshold or when the authorized observation window ends.

state_transitions.interpretation: Initial public evidence-state freeze. This records what StructureEvidence accepted by the knowledge cutoff; it does not backdate later knowledge to the underlying event dates.

reopen_triggers.condition: A named customer shipment and acceptance record becomes publicly verifiable.
reopen_triggers.minimum_evidence: Dated attributable shipment plus customer acceptance.

reopen_triggers.condition: A named site commissioning or grid-connection record becomes publicly verifiable.
reopen_triggers.minimum_evidence: Named operator, site, system boundary, commissioning date, and operating status.

reopen_triggers.condition: Dated operating-history evidence tied to a named system becomes available.
reopen_triggers.minimum_evidence: Runtime, duty cycle, availability, degradation, incidents, and maintenance.

reopen_triggers.condition: Independent or customer-linked field validation becomes publicly verifiable.
reopen_triggers.minimum_evidence: Traceable system identity, method, boundary, and measured performance.

reopen_triggers.condition: Repeat procurement or multi-operator replication becomes publicly verifiable.
reopen_triggers.minimum_evidence: Multiple attributable deployments across a defined market boundary; no universal replacement inference is automatic.

data_provenance.ownership_boundary: Underlying public facts and source publications remain external/public. The StructureEvidence-derived asset is the normalized scope, source dependency, temporal indexing, accepted support, explicit non-support, unknown structure, state transition history, reopen logic, and later outcome linkage.
data_provenance.reproducibility_note: A third party may re-read the public sources, but reproducing the same historical decision memory requires preserving what was accepted, rejected, unknown, and frozen at each knowledge cutoff.

revision_history.change_summary: Initial Decision Memory sidecar created from the frozen sodium-ion BESS public state v0.1 without modifying that historical snapshot.
